title: The Cat and the Dragon Anime Unveils 1st Promo Video, 3 More Cast Members, July 4 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Amara 's Neko to Ryū ( The Cat and the Dragon ) novels revealed on Thursday the anime's first promotional video, additional cast members, and July 4 debut.
author: ANN

title: 'Mebius Dust' Unveils Additional Cast, Staff, Ending Theme, Main Promo
content: The official website for the Mebius Dust television anime unveiled additional cast, staff, ending theme, a key visual, and the main promotional video on Thursday. The anime will premiere on Tokyo MX at 11.30 p.m. followed by BS Fuji and MBS on July 9.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Manga 'Gifted' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: Publishing company Kodansha announced a television anime adaptation of Shin Kibayashi and Rima Amamiya 's Gifted manga on Thursday, revealing an announcement visual (pictured above). The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 New Trailer Introduces Ending Theme Song by Mika Nakashima
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed a new trailer and ending theme song by Mika Nakashima ahead of the anime’s July 5 premiere. The anime previously confirmed a July 2026 premiere , with Crunchyroll confirmed to stream worldwide. The previous trailer introduces the opening song by Yuiko Ohara .
author: Anime Corner

title: Supporting Cast Pair for 'Kabushikigaisha Magi-Lumière 2nd Season' Annoucened
content: • The official website of the Kabushikigaisha Magi-Lumière 2nd Season ( Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc. Season 2 ) television anime announced a supporting pair of cast on Thursday. The anime series adapting, Sekka Iwata and Yuu Aoki 's mahou shoujo manga is scheduled to premiere on Nippon TV at 1:05 a.m. on July 5.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Neko to Ryuu' Reveals Supporting Cast, New Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Amara 's Neko to Ryuu ( The Cat and the Dragon ) light novel revealed supporting cast and a new promotional video on Thursday. The anime will premiere on Tokyo MX at 9:00 p.m. on July 4, followed by broadcasts on BS NTV and Yomiuri TV.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Bungo Stray Dogs Gets New Spinoff Manga on July 3
content: The July issue of Kadokawa 's Young Ace magazine revealed on Thursday that Shikiji Sorakura will launch a new spinoff manga for the Bungō Stray Dogs franchise in the magazine's next issue on July 3.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Debuts 12 'Mini-Episodes' of Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You Anime Ahead of July Premiere
content: Crunchyroll added the first 12 mini-episodes of the television anime of Jinushi 's Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You ( Super no Ura de Yani Sū Futari ) manga on Wednesday.
author: ANN
